name: Taroky Nebraska

history.origins: Country/Region of Origin: USA (Nebraska), Czech Republic (Bohemian roots). Rules based on variants played around 1900 in the Bohemian Crown (Habsburg Empire). Preserved by Czech-American communities in the American Midwest.
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide

setup.players: Four active players. A fifth may take part as non-playing dealer who deals to the other four and does not take part in play or scoring for that deal. Play is clockwise, unlike European Taroky.

rules.objective: Win tricks with valuable cards; bidder chooses partner by calling a King. Count cards in packets of three, subtract 2 per packet. Bonuses for declared combinations.
rules.gameplay: 1. Deal: 12 cards each, 6 in blind. 2. Bidding; bidder calls a King for partner (not trump XIX). 3. Play 12 tricks clockwise; follow suit, trump if void. 4. Score: count cards in packets of three, subtract 2 per packet; bonuses for declared combinations. Settlements after each hand.
